meta.title: Open PDF Studio — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: Free, open-source PDF editor for construction drawings: mark up, measure to scale, compare revisions, organize pages and share safely. Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and web.

header.label: PDF editor for construction
header.title: Open PDF Studio
header.tagline: Free PDF editor to mark up, measure and compare drawings
header.desc: Open construction drawings without waiting, add clouds and symbols, measure to scale and see at a glance what changed between two revisions. On your computer, your tablet or right in the browser.
header.proofEngine: Own PDF engine for vector drawings
header.heroAlt: Open PDF Studio: floor plan of a house with a revision cloud, a callout and a measured area of 21.08 m²

notice.text: Try it right away: open your own PDF in the browser. The file stays on your own computer and is never uploaded.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything for your drawings, in one app
features.sub: Start with the highlights, or pick a topic.
features.ribbon: The complete ribbon, feature by feature

drawings.alt: Floor plan of a house fitted to the window, with thumbnails of the three sheets
drawings.title: Open large drawings without waiting
drawings.desc: In the desktop app, a custom PDF engine written in Rust renders vector PDFs instantly, including large sheets and sets of hundreds of pages. Work with several drawings in tabs and jump to the right sheet with the thumbnails.

annotate.alt: Revision cloud, callout and NEN 1414 fire safety symbols on a floor plan, with the tool palette open
annotate.title: Mark up what needs to change
annotate.desc: Clouds, arrows, callouts, notes and stamps, plus a tool palette with NEN 1414 and IFC symbols. Every markup has an author, a status and replies, so you can resolve comments together.

measure.alt: Floor plan at 1:50 with two measured areas and a distance of 8.40 m
measure.title: Measure to scale, even with several scales per sheet
measure.desc: Place a scale region on the drawing and measure distances, areas, perimeters and angles, snapping to endpoints and midpoints. Every measurement goes into a quantity schedule that you can place on the drawing as a table or save as CSV.

compare.alt: Revisions A and B overlaid: the moved kitchen wall in red and green, with a list of six changes
compare.title: See right away what changed between two revisions
compare.desc: Overlay two versions, show them side by side or use a swipe line. What was added turns green, what was removed turns red, and a list sums up every change.

pages.alt: Edit Pages: six sheets as thumbnails, with the sheets of revision B inserted
pages.title: Put your drawing set together
pages.desc: Reorder, rotate, delete and split pages in a thumbnail overview, and insert pages from another file. When you merge, markups, measurements, form fields and bookmarks come along.

share.alt: Drawing with the watermark CONCEPT and a blacked-out project block in the title block
share.title: Share your drawing the way you want
share.desc: Add a watermark or a header and footer, cover sensitive details and sign with your signature. Print in colour, grayscale or black and white, or save sheets as images.

markup.title: 20+ markup tools
markup.desc: Highlight, underline, strike through, clouds, arrows, shapes, freehand, text boxes, callouts and notes.

symbols.title: Symbols for construction
symbols.desc: A tool palette with NEN 1414 and IFC symbols, plus parametric symbols such as reinforcement, CPT soundings and a tower crane with slewing radius.

review.title: Resolve comments
review.desc: Every markup has an author, status and replies. The annotation list and markup layers keep large sets organized.

toolsets.title: Tool sets
toolsets.desc: Save your markup styles and measurement presets in sets and share them with colleagues as an .opdstools file.

cad.title: Draw like in CAD
cad.desc: Lines, arcs, hatches and dimensions, with move, mirror, array and rotate. Frames with a title block are filled in separately.

snippet.title: Vector snippet
snippet.desc: Cut a detail from one PDF and paste it into another, as sharp vector data instead of a screenshot.

measure.title: Distance, area, perimeter and angle
measure.desc: Measure in mm, cm, m, inches or feet, snapping to endpoints, midpoints, vertices and centres.

scale.title: Scale regions
scale.desc: Several scales on one sheet, from 1:1 to 1:200 or a custom scale. Or measure the scale on the drawing itself.

quantities.title: Quantity schedule
quantities.desc: Areas, lengths and counts per IFC category, as a table on the drawing or as CSV for your cost estimate.

count.title: Count
count.desc: Count symbols and items with one click each; the total goes into the quantity schedule.

organize.title: Edit pages
organize.desc: Reorder, rotate, delete, insert and split in a zoomable overview. Nothing changes until you click Apply.

merge.title: Merge and split
merge.desc: Merge PDFs while keeping markups, measurements, form fields, bookmarks and layers, or split a set into separate sheets.

compare.title: Compare and split view
compare.desc: Compare two revisions as overlay, side by side or with a swipe line, or view two parts of one drawing side by side.

edit.title: Edit and recognize text
edit.desc: Change existing text or add new text. In the desktop app, text recognition (OCR) makes scans searchable.

watermark.title: Watermarks, headers and footers
watermark.desc: Text or image, with opacity, rotation and position. Headers and footers with page number, date and file name.

redact.title: Cover details
redact.desc: Mark areas with names, addresses or prices and cover them before you share the drawing.

sign.title: Signatures and stamps
sign.desc: Draw your signature and keep a few for later. Ten ready-made stamps, or make one from an image.

print.title: Print and export
print.desc: Print in colour, grayscale or black and white, with preview. Save sheets as PNG or JPEG up to 600 dpi, or as a raster PDF.

forms.title: Forms
forms.desc: Fill in interactive PDF forms and create your own text fields, check boxes and radio buttons.

recovery.title: Work that survives a crash
recovery.desc: The app keeps a recovery copy of every document with unsaved changes. Your original file is never touched.

shortcuts.title: Your own shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: Give every command and ribbon button its own shortcut, and take them along to another computer.

languages.title: 39 languages and five themes
languages.desc: Including right-to-left for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu. Dark, light, blue, high contrast or system.

ai.title: Operable by AI
ai.desc: A built-in MCP server lets an AI assistant such as Claude measure, mark up and save, with 102 tools.

download.label: Download
download.title: Download v2026.44.4
download.lead: Free, no account needed. For Windows, macOS and Linux, and as an app for Android tablets.
download.browserNote: Rather not install anything? The app also runs fully in the browser, and your file stays on your own computer.
download.mobileNote: On an iPhone or iPad, Open PDF Studio runs in the browser. Open it here, or download the app on your computer.

whatsnew.label: New in v2026.44
whatsnew.title: Split view and your own shortcuts
whatsnew.desc: View two parts of a drawing side by side, keep your styles in tool sets and set your own keyboard shortcuts. With contributions from the community. The full list is in the release notes.

split.title: Split view
split.desc: Two parts of the same document side by side, each with its own zoom and page.

toolsets.title: Tool sets
toolsets.desc: Keep markup styles and measurement presets in sets, and exchange them as an .opdstools file.

pages.title: Edit Pages
pages.desc: A new overview with zoomable thumbnails to reorder, rotate, delete, insert and split.

shortcuts.title: Your own shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: Assign a shortcut to every command and ribbon button, and import or export them.

print.title: Printing and saving
print.desc: Print in grayscale or black and white, and stop a long save with Cancel or Esc.

files.title: Smaller files
files.desc: Drawings with dot hatches are saved much smaller, for example 194 KB instead of 45.6 MB.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Open PDF Studio also runs fully in the browser, and your PDF stays on your own computer. For heavy work there are versions for Windows, macOS and Linux, and an app for Android.

price.q: What does Open PDF Studio cost?
price.a: Nothing. The app is free and open source under the LGPL-3.0 license. No subscription, no per-user license fees and no telemetry.

scale.a: Yes. You place a scale region on the drawing, with a fixed scale such as 1:50 or 1:100, or a scale you measure on the drawing itself. A sheet can have several scale regions, for example for a floor plan and a detail.

compare.q: Can I compare two revisions of a drawing?
compare.a: Yes. Open both files and choose Compare PDFs. You see the versions overlaid, side by side or with a swipe line. Added parts turn green, removed parts red, and a list sums up the changes.

readers.a: Yes. Markups are saved as standard PDF annotations, so other PDF readers show them too. If you want them fixed, flatten them into the page content.

tablet.q: Does it work on a tablet?
tablet.a: Yes. There is an app (.apk) for Android tablets, and on an iPad the web version runs in the browser. Handy for having your drawings at hand on site.

languages.a: 39 languages, including right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu.

ai.q: What can an AI assistant do with my PDF?
ai.a: The desktop app has a built-in MCP server (Model Context Protocol, an open standard). With it, an AI assistant such as Claude can operate the app: every ribbon feature, plus 102 tools to measure, mark up and save. The server runs on your own computer; the file itself is not sent to an external service.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: A thin native shell in Rust for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, with a small installer.

engine.title: PDF engine in Rust
engine.desc: In the desktop app, a custom engine renders vector PDFs such as construction drawings, without JavaScript delays.

solid.title: SolidJS
solid.desc: A reactive interface with fine-grained updates, even with hundreds of markups.

pdfjs.title: PDF.js and pdf-lib
pdfjs.desc: Mozilla PDF.js for rendering in the browser, pdf-lib to edit and save documents.

ifc.title: IFC categories
ifc.desc: Symbols and measurements get an IFC category, so quantities connect to BIM.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.desc: In the desktop app, a built-in MCP server offers 102 tools to an AI client.
